items.root_cause: a rule edit and its matching review were two steps that could drift apart, and one alert type hid which of three conditions had fired. The commit gate compared the staged rules with the WORKING-TREE baseline, so an accept that never reached a commit passed it (5 authored rule commits in 11 days left the committed baseline behind the committed rules), and the daily audit read whatever state its checkout held (an in-flight edit on 2026-09-19). The same subject carried the rule-change diff, the arrival review (NEW-CONTESTED) and the matcher self-check (drift), so 12 arrival days scored as RETURNs of rule-review closes and no reader could tell an authored edit from a drift nobody authored

root_fix.what: make review and commit one step at the gate, and make the alert say which condition fired and why. The gate reads the baseline THIS COMMIT CARRIES (the index entry, a pathspec commit's temporary index included) and names the commonest refusal (accepted on disk, not staged). The audit files each condition as its own type through Send-AlertConditions, and a MOVED/DROPPED diff carries its cause read from git and the rules hash: RULE EDIT IN PROGRESS (the rule files differ from HEAD), RULE CHANGE UNREVIEWED (HEAD's rules hash is not the baseline's, or cannot be read), MOVED WITH NO RULE CHANGE (equal hashes: the matcher code or the baseline file moved, the one drift nobody authored). NEW CONTESTED and MATCHER DRIFT are their own types. Each is re-sent only when its own findings change.
root_fix.exact_change: verify-commodities-gate.ps1: Get-RulesHashFromBaselineText and Get-IndexBaselineHash (Save-GitBlob of ':grocery/out/audit/match-baseline.json'); the live verdict is Test-BaselineCoversRules(staged rules hash, INDEX baseline hash); an 'accepted but not staged' branch when the working-tree hash would have covered them; header rewritten. audit-match-soundness.ps1: pure Get-RegressionCause, Get-SoundnessConditions, Select-ChangedConditions, Read-SoundnessSigs; a CAUSE line on the console whenever MOVED/DROPPED > 0; the -Alert block sends Send-AlertConditions -SubjectPrefix 'Grocery matching soundness' with per-label signatures in soundness-alert-sig.txt (the old one-hash file reads as empty, so each current condition is sent once under its new type); exit codes unchanged (2 still holds publish). alert-registry.json: five review-class entries split_from plan-2026-09-21-7.json, the aggregate entry kept with a 'retired' line.
